Act as a school's administrator to reproduce a fault, with every such session recorded and visible to that school.

Build and change the timetable for any class or section in the department: pick the class, drop a subject and a teacher into a period, and publish. This is the head of department's own copy of the whole-school grid, narrowed to the classes they are responsible for.
Every teacher in the department, period by period, with their free periods visible. Assign a teacher to a period, move them off one, and see the clash before it is saved rather than after.
The department's grid by class, by faculty and by room, read together so a gap in one is explained by the other two.

Which teacher teaches which subject to which section, across the department, with each teacher's total periods shown so the load can be seen while it is being set.

Leave requested by your own department's staff, with the periods it would leave uncovered shown beside it. Either you or the principal may approve; whoever gets there first decides it.
Own details and password.

What your head of department, the principal or a parent has written about you. You are told when one is added.
Write a remark about one of your child's teachers. It reaches the head of department and the teacher.
Leave the department heads have passed up, and long leave that needs the principal's signature. Shows who is away today across the school and which periods are still uncovered.
